issues.issue: Every figure reconciles exactly: 17,769 + 230,000 + 347,516 = 595,285 (line 16). 313,173 + 229,809 = 542,982. 595,285 - 542,982 = 52,303 = lines 28/31. So 542,982 is the total disbursements written one line low (on line 26). The 490,679 (542,982 - 52,303) is only the gap that misplacement creates between line 26 and line 31; no money is missing. Keeping this entry is defensible, but its check type would be 'reconcile' (line 26 vs line 31), not 'totals'. Calling it a 490,679 'report doesn't add up' item overstates the problem. All JSON amounts (ending_cash 52,303; computed disbursement total 542,982) are correct.
Assumed to be a private grant; the page doesn't say who gave it. It could be a government grant.
60% of receipts are in 'other'. For an agricultural society this is probably fair/event revenue, but the page gives no breakdown.
